analysis: attention-path decomposition of the joint_768 readouts by block, source token and region
cells: 2000 random labelled CV cells (pandas sample, random_state=0); each read by its out-of-fold joint_768 readout
regions: linear_cv_regions.region_masks; patch writes split by pixel fraction, and as a check by interior patches only, with boundary patches as their own group
statistic: Cov(T_g, Y) / Var(Y) over cells, Y = w'(z - beta); const, cls, nucleus, cytoplasm, rest and mlp sum to 1, as do const, cls, the interior regions, boundary and mlp; in shares_all_blocks, boundary and topnorm are side numbers inside the regions
